description: Manage visual memory snapshots. Actions: "save" creates a named checkpoint of current states; "diff" compares two snapshots for visual drift/regression; "export" serializes a snapshot to a portable JSON archive; "restore" imports a snapshot from an exported archive.

archive_json.description: JSON string of exported SnapshotArchive (required for restore)

description.description: Notes describing snapshot context (used with save)

snapshot_b_name.description: Target snapshot name to compare against (required for diff)

state_memory_milestone_id.description: Optional state-memory milestone ID to correlate

state_memory_snapshot_id.description: Optional state-memory snapshot ID to correlate

name: manage_snapshot
